content.comment_body: Hello, I am using a [product_name] to count jars on a production line and display both the total count and average jars per hour. This information is shown through a custom web server on a screen. I would like to add a text box on the web page so operators can enter details, such as batch numbers, directly from the interface. Is it possible to make a writable text box, similar to how analog values can be edited? Thanks in advance.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is looking for ways to improve the custom web server function of a [product_name] by enabling operators to enter batch-specific details via an editable text field on the web interface. However, the current limitation is that editable text fields are not supported—operators can only view data, not input custom information.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes the custom web server could allow editable text fields for operators to enter information such as batch numbers, similar to how analog values can be adjusted.
